subject: Request to defer PO requirement for Illumina pilot — onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@illumina.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina.patel@illumina.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding — PO requirement?

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Illumina integration looks promising for our sequencing ops team. Procurement has flagged that our standard process requires a purchase order before vendor billing. For this initial pilot (3 months, limited infra), can Redwood accept invoices without a PO while we finalize internal approval?

If a temporary exception is possible, procurement would still need a signed SOW and evidence of insurance plus an onboarding form. Can you confirm the exact docs Redwood needs and whether you can route the invoice to our AP without a PO in the short term?

Appreciate a quick note so we can move the pilot forward.

Best,
Alex Ramos
Senior Program Manager, Illumina AI
[Attachment: Illumina_Pilot_Overview.pdf (pdf)]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@illumina.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — PO requirement?

Alex —

Thanks for the clear note. Short answer: we can often accommodate a short-term PO deferral for pilots, but we need to lock a few controls so Finance and Legal remain comfortable. To make the internal approval smooth on our side please:

- Return the signed SOW (we can accept DocuSign)
- Complete our onboarding spreadsheet (I attached the fillable form)
- Provide proof of insurance (COI)

If you can provide those items, Ben will evaluate whether we can route invoices to AP with a temporary PO waiver for up to 90 days. If Finance signs off, invoicing should go to ap@illumina.ai with an internal reference — we'll still require a retroactive PO if procurement later issues one, and invoices will be matched accordingly.

Attached: Redwood_Onboarding_Form_illumina.xlsx (please fill proprietor/company tax ID and remittance address).

Proposed next steps:
1) Illumina completes form + returns signed SOW
2) Ben reviews and confirms whether the 90-day deferral is approved
3) If approved, I’ll send an onboarding checklist and interim invoice routing instructions

Marissa — tagging you to help coordinate signatures and any SOW edits. Ben — can you confirm whether the deferral needs any additional approvals?

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Vendor Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Onboarding_Form_illumina.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — PO requirement?

Irene / Marissa —

I reviewed Illumina’s onboarding summary that Alex sent. Finance is open to a limited, documented deferral for pilots under two conditions:

1) A signed SOW evidencing scope and term
2) Completed onboarding form with tax and remittance details
3) AP contact and PO request owner identified on Illumina side (so we can reconcile if a PO is later issued)

If those are in place, I’ll approve invoices to be processed without a PO for up to 90 days. We’ll require a short finance waiver memo (I can draft) that will be appended to the vendor record. Also: any invoices over $50k will still require escalation to Procurement.

Irene — once Illumina returns the docs I’ll run the waiver memo and confirm routing.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Finance_PO_Deferral_Template.docx (docx)]

From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@illumina.ai>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@illumina.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — PO requirement?

Hi all,

Per procurement, we can provide the signed SOW and COI today. I’ve attached the SOW for signature and populated the onboarding spreadsheet with our remittance details. We do not expect invoices to exceed $10k per month for the pilot. AP contact is payables@illumina.ai; PO owner will be procurement lead (procurement@illumina.ai).

Forwarding: 
- Signed_SOW_Illumina_v1.pdf (attached)
- Filled_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (attached)
- COI_Illumina_2027.pdf (attached)

Alex — please confirm you’ve shared the files. Irene / Ben — please advise if anything else is required.

Thanks,
Nina Patel
Procurement Coordinator, Illumina AI
[Attachments: Signed_SOW_Illumina_v1.pdf, Filled_Onboarding_Form.xlsx, COI_Illumina_2027.pdf]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@illumina.ai>, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@illumina.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — PO requirement?

Nina / Alex —

Thanks for the speedy turnaround and for attaching the docs. I reviewed the filled onboarding form and the SOW. All good on our side. Ben has approved a 90-day PO deferral for this engagement (ILM-2027-PILOT-042) with the following conditions documented in the vendor record:

- Scope limited to the SOW signed 2027-06-29
- Maximum invoice threshold for deferral set to $50k total across the 90-day window
- AP contact: payables@illumina.ai (Illumina internal reference required on each invoice)
- Finance waiver memo appended to vendor onboarding folder

Next steps for Illumina:
- Send first invoice to payables@illumina.ai and cc billing@redwood.com with invoice reference: ILM-PILOT-042
- If procurement issues a PO later, include the PO number on future invoices; we will reconcile against any invoices already paid under the deferral

Marissa will complete the vendor intake in our system and attach the COI + SOW. I’ll circulate the formal waiver memo and onboarding checklist for your records.

Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk through invoicing fields to avoid delays.

Best,
Irene Choi
Vendor Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0124
